```artifact
```xUnit Test Cases
// Doorstop Functional Requirements Test Suite

// Test Case for REQ011: Permanent and Secure Storage of Requirements
test_case_permanent_secure_storage = {
  name: "test_case_permanent_secure_storage",
  req_ids: ["REQ011"],
  kind: "positive",
  preconditions: ["Doorstop is initialized"],
  inputs: {},
  steps: ["Store a requirement in Doorstop", "Retrieve the requirement"],
  expected: ["Requirement is stored securely", "Requirement can be retrieved without corruption"]
}

// Test Case for REQ012: Change Management of Requirements
test_case_change_management = {
  name: "test_case_change_management",
  req_ids: ["REQ012"],
  kind: "positive",
  preconditions: ["Doorstop is initialized", "Requirement exists"],
  inputs: {"change_description": "Updated requirement details"},
  steps: ["Apply change to requirement", "Retrieve the updated requirement"],
  expected: ["Change is managed correctly", "Updated requirement reflects change"]
}

// Test Case for REQ013: Associating Requirements Changes to Developer Identification
test_case_developer_association = {
  name: "test_case_developer_association",
  req_ids: ["REQ013"],
  kind: "positive",
  preconditions: ["Doorstop is initialized", "Requirement exists", "Developer is identified"],
  inputs: {"change_description": "Updated requirement details", "developer_id": "Developer's ID"},
  steps: ["Apply change to requirement", "Associate change with developer", "Retrieve the updated requirement"],
  expected: ["Change is associated with developer", "Updated requirement reflects change"]
}

// Test Case for REQ014: Scalability for Thousands of Requirements
test_case_scalability = {
  name: "test_case_scalability",
  req_ids: ["REQ014"],
  kind: "positive",
  preconditions: ["Doorstop is initialized"],
  inputs: {"requirements_count": "1000"},
  steps: ["Store multiple requirements", "Retrieve a requirement"],
  expected: ["Requirements are stored without performance degradation", "Retrieval is fast"]
}

// Test Case for REQ015: Lightweight Installation Method
test_case_installation_method = {
  name: "test_case_installation_method",
  req_ids: ["REQ015"],
  kind: "positive",
  preconditions: ["Doorstop is available for installation"],
  inputs: {"installation_method": "Lightweight"},
  steps: ["Install Doorstop", "Verify installation method"],
  expected: ["Installation is successful", "Installation method is lightweight"]
}
